# Agriculture official public source fixtures

These reduced fixtures retain actual public title, link and publication date fields obtained from official HTTP responses on 2026-10-12. Items from the Taiwan-local week starting 2026-10-05 are preferred when the live feed includes them; otherwise the most recent real entries are retained without altering dates.

The audit maps each enabled candidate to its route ID and fixture path. Discovery HTML files are evidence for pending selector work, not proof of an enabled route. Museum platforms cannot inherit a parent institution's unfiltered feed; media foundations' daily reporting feeds are excluded from institution news.

Run the repository's validate_source_candidates example against the agriculture audit to confirm the existing Rust adapter parses the mapped fixtures before merging source definitions.
